description: Claude Code after the user pressed Esc on a turn: it prints '⎿  Interrupted · What should Claude do instead?' under the cancelled turn and returns to an empty ❯ input box. That is the user's own interrupt and Claude is idle at its prompt; the parser read the notice as a pending text question, so the pane showed as Needs you. classify() now treats an interrupt notice with no newer turn or typed row above an empty input box as idle with no question (tests/test_classify.py proves the override; this sample guards the shape). Anonymised live capture (tmux-rc, 2026-10-14).
